name: Dart
criteria: Statically typed, null-safe with records, sealed classes and switch pattern matching, collection-for/if literals; AOT-compiled so tight loops are fast; nice for typed simulations and grid search.
build: mkdir -p .build && if [ ! -f .build/main ] || [ -n "$(find . -name '*.dart' -newer .build/main)" ]; then dart compile exe -o .build/main main.dart >/dev/null; fi
